title: Add a menuSelect widget
body:
<!--
  ***************************
  Thanks for participating in this project!

  This form is to report issues or new features.
  As for general questions like "How to do routing using React InstantSearch",
  please search or post a question to our discourse forum: https://discourse.algolia.com/.

  In any case,
    - make sure you are using the latest version of the library;
    - do at least one search in current issues or questions, your question might already be answered;
    - do include details, screenshots when it's a visual issue, console errors otherwise;
  ***************************
-->

**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
feature

**Feature: What is your use case for such a feature?**
Redering a Menu as a select has been asked too many times to be ignored anymore. We need a menuSelect no matter how far we go in providing advanced rendering customisation.

**Feature: What is your proposed API entry? The new option to add? What is the behavior?**

```js
search.addWidget(instantsearch.widgets.menuSelect({
  attributeName: '...',
  limit: ...
  label: '...'
}));
```

This should render:

```html
<label>... <select><option></option></select></label>
```

Ref: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/868

**What project are you opening an issue for?**
- instantsearch.js

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**
latest

comments.body:
thank you! 
my comment from another related issue--
> this would be very nice as a basic builtin for instantsearch.js. Would make Algolia instantsearch.js a lot more mobile friendly, which would of course help the bulk of our 1m+ monthly unique users.
Now that v2 has connectors this should be fairly trivial to implement with `connectMenu`. Let's move forward with it based on the options of `menu`.

This is an example of `connectMenu`  as a `selectMenu`

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/dev/app/custom-widgets/vanilla/selectMenu.js

This has been released in [2.2](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md#features) ([see the doc](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/menuSelect.html))
